mentions.name: Web-based Lightroom replacement
mentions.description: A small web-based photo organizer and editor that replaces Adobe's apps by implementing just the tiny subset of Lightroom features the author needs for their photography workflow.
mentions.problem: The author dislikes the encroachment of AI features into Adobe's apps and finds Lightroom more than they need, so they are building a minimal alternative for their own workflow.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm not a big fan of the encroachment of AI into Adobe's apps, so I'm using AI to build a replacement for those apps (a small web-based photo organizer and editor, just the tiny subset of the Lightroom features I need for my workflow)
mentions.author: cec
